steps.message:
# Some coins misbehave in the flooded cave

### What happens
`recording.mp4` is an uncut run through a flooded cave basin. Partway through the clip, Tux does something that releases a group of new coins. From that moment until the end of the clip, those coins do not behave the way coins in this game should. The coins that were already placed in the level, Tux, the fish and the scenery in the recording are correct.

### Expected
The released coins should behave like a normal coin burst in this game, from the moment they spread out of the block until they come to rest and Tux swims back to collect them. Once a coin is in the water it should drift down slowly. Fix every way the released coins behave wrongly in the recording.

## Attached visual evidence

- `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4` (44 seconds)

You can inspect individual moments of the video by extracting frames from it with `ffmpeg`.

Inspect the attached file before making changes.

steps.message:
I fixed three bugs in how burst coins behave, and the game builds cleanly. I couldn't watch the recording: `/app/.harbor_assets/` is empty and there's no `recording.mp4` anywhere on the system. So I found these bugs by reading the burst-coin code against how other falling objects in the game work. I also haven't played a level to watch the fixed coins. If the video shows something I haven't covered, send it again and I'll compare.

**What I changed:**

1. **Spread direction** (`src/object/coin_explode.cpp`): the left/right sign was applied to the vertical speed instead of the horizontal one. All ten coins flew off to the same side, and half of them were shot downward instead of up. Now they fan out up and to both sides.

2. **Coming to rest** (`src/object/coin.cpp`, `HeavyCoin::collision_solid`):
   - Coins bounced again whenever they landed faster than 20, which is almost always, so they kept hopping. They now bounce only above 200.
   - When a coin landed it kept its sideways speed and slid along the floor forever. Its sideways speed now drops to zero when it settles, so Tux can swim back and collect it.

3. **Water** (`src/object/coin.cpp`, `HeavyCoin::update`): burst coins ignored water and fell at full speed. Now, when a coin is touching water:
   - gravity is cut to 20% and movement is slowed, the same way the game already handles rocks in water;
   - its downward speed is capped at 100, so it drifts down slowly.

   The 100 cap is my own choice; nothing in the code sets that number. Change it if you want coins to sink faster or slower.
